Software and reproducible research projects.

## [cholrot](./cholrot/)

`cholrot` is an alpha-stage scientific Python package for rank-one Cholesky updates, downdates, modified-factor products, and solves, with C++/pybind11 kernels and pure Python fallbacks.

[Project page](./cholrot/) · [GitHub](https://github.com/smiryusupov/cholrot) · [PyPI](https://pypi.org/project/cholrot/) · [Documentation](https://cholrot.readthedocs.io/)

## [lattice-dsp](./lattice-dsp/)

`lattice-dsp` is an alpha-stage scientific Python package for stable IIR lattice filters, adaptive recursive DSP, finite-Hankel model-reduction diagnostics, and experimental matrix/MIMO lattice workflows, with C++/pybind11 kernels and optional OpenMP batch processing.

[Project page](./lattice-dsp/) · [GitHub](https://github.com/smiryusupov/lattice-dsp) · [PyPI](https://pypi.org/project/lattice-dsp/) · [Documentation](https://lattice-dsp.readthedocs.io/)
